messages.text: Propose Wayfarer Trade and Lantern Maintain: prepared Beacon reaches three, our contract completes, and wear returns Beacon to two. Request Hold and Guard. We keep the route usable and Guard offsets this month's dwindling stores. There is no compulsory Guild service under Interim. Do not volunteer both ships for a military venture before we have an actual bargain.

delivered_contributions.reason: This is a credible independent plan with visible public benefit from maintenance. It preserves both assets and our constitutional leverage while meeting one commercial obligation. I know Guard means conditioning declines unless the army finds another lawful combat arrangement. That is a subject for negotiation, not a reason to grant permanent carriage rights.

messages.text: I agree with your draft. Maintenance gives us prepared Beacon three, so this commercial voyage does not depend on the army keeping a protection promise. I will request Guard for the communities, but I want Vigil actually offered and the Ascendant's final order written before counting that benefit. We must also avoid a Warrant consuming the same garrison.

delivered_contributions.reason: This proposal protects our people while completing an existing obligation. It leaves the council no grounds to assume either Guild vessel is available. Readiness declining concerns me, but an unfunded Campaign or speculative Raid is not a sound substitute for an agreed plan. If new information identifies a concrete danger, I will reconsider the draft before signing; this agreement is not yet a commitment.
